verdict.rationale: A payments platform with a Console could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only an official MCP server that lets an external assistant (Claude) act on TrueLayer. That belongs to a different story and is not an assistant built into TrueLayer's own product or Console, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
